label: Necessary-predecessor lifting entails no novel necessary support (inference)
rule: Conjunct projection: the actual support edge is the last conjunct of lifting; the weak version's extra hypothesis that the source is necessary is unused
meaning: Strength order registration: if every possible supporter of a necessary individual lifts to a necessary, actually present supporter of it, then every possible support edge between necessary individuals already holds at the actual world. Same model, support relation and actual world. Establishes neither statement. Strictness: the contingent-source model.
